Intel explicitly states it suspended quarterly dividends starting Q4 2024 due to a focus on critical investments, whereas Micron declared and paid a quarterly dividend of $0.115 per share in September 2024. While both companies reference Board discretion, Intel's action is a mandatory suspension linked to external agreement constraints, contrasting with Micron's active payout.
